quotes.author: Jen Mann
quotes.text: Sent my daughter and my husband up today with Mauro and Carlos. My daughter was scheduled to go already but when my husband had FOMO, Mauro made it happen. Both Mauro and Carlos were fantastic at making everyone feel safe and relaxed. Highly recommend.

quotes.author: Charlotte Beckett
quotes.text: Great experience for first timers! I had a fantastic first time, Mauro my instructor was very good at trying to settle my nerves, keeping me talking. Instructions were clear from everyone and I would definitely skydive with them again! Thanks guys!

quotes.author: Prophet
quotes.text: Went early and i had a great time. I had a great instructor who explained everything clearly. The jump was great, I got to steer a bit. Smooth landing!
